knowledge_units.context_summary: The authors developed a framework for three-dimensional topological valley photonics featuring a complete photonic bandgap and vectorial valley-contrasting physics. This 3D system utilizes triple pairs of valleys characterized by valley Chern vectors, unlike 2D systems which use scalar invariants. The work demonstrates vectorial bulk valley vortices and canalized chiral valley surface states governed by the right-hand-thumb rule.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The study introduces a 3D topological valley photonic crystal framework that utilizes a complete photonic bandgap to overcome the limitations of 2D systems, such as out-of-plane losses and planar confinement. This 3D model features triple pairs of valleys characterized by vectorial valley Chern numbers, enabling the creation of canalized chiral valley surface states on all surfaces. The authors experimentally verified the vectorial valley-contrasting physics using a pump-probe method with a vectorial chiral source array.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The 3D photonic crystal design uses PEC rods of specific diameters to suppress high-order modes and create a clean band structure. When inversion symmetry is broken, the crystal exhibits a complete photonic bandgap with six valleys grouped by time-reversal symmetry. The eigenstates at these valleys display vortex profiles with opposite chirality and vectorial Berry curvature.

attributes.structure_type: photonic diamond with PEC spheres and rods

knowledge_units.context_summary: The study derives an effective Hamiltonian for 3D topological valley photonics using the k·p method, identifying a mass term induced by broken inversion symmetry. It describes a vectorial chiral source array configuration used to selectively excite valley states based on chirality-matched phase winding. Experimental measurements at 13.8 GHz confirm that the outcoupling direction of these states corresponds to specific valley momenta, demonstrating single-directional 3D radiation.

relationships.target: phase winding on x-y, y-z, and x-z planes
valley states at the same frequency

attributes.2D_behavior: restrained in 2D plane, diverges in vertical direction

knowledge_units.context_summary: The 3D valley photonic crystal (VPC) exhibits vectorial Berry curvatures that define valley Chern vectors (VCVs) for its six valleys. Topological chiral surface states exist on the (001) surface when specific boundary conditions are met, characterized by a linear dispersion relation dependent on the VCV. Experimental realization involves modifying the surface with a metallic plate and tuning sphere diameter and distance to satisfy these conditions.

attributes.structure: face-centered-cubic (fcc) lattice with PEC spheres and rods

attributes.definition: Integral of Berry curvature over a planar region around a valley

attributes.tuning_parameters: diameter of outmost metallic sphere (D3) and distance to plate (h)

attributes.role: manifests band topology around each valley

knowledge_units.context_summary: The study demonstrates that 3D topological valley photonic crystals support chiral surface states with linear dispersion within the complete photonic bandgap. These states exhibit canalization behavior, propagating diffractionlessly along specific directions locked to the valley index. The surface states are robust and can exist on all sample surfaces, unlike conventional 3D topological insulators.

attributes.cause: flat isofrequency contour of surface states

relationships.target: topological transition point between open hyperbolic and closed elliptical isofrequency contours

knowledge_units.context_summary: The 3D valley photonic crystal supports chiral surface states that propagate in specific directions on different crystal faces, forming closed loops without intervalley scattering. The relationship between the Valley Chern Vector (VCV) direction and the surface state circulation direction follows the right-hand-thumb rule. Experimental measurements confirm that surface states at the Wx- valley propagate along +y on the (001) surface and -z on the (010) surface, maintaining valley locking.

attributes.propagation_behavior: forms closed loops across (001) and (010) surfaces

attributes.relation_to_surface_states: Direction related to circulation via right-hand-thumb rule

relationships.target: circulating direction of valley surface states

attributes.description: Thumb points to VCV direction, curling fingers point to surface state circulation direction

attributes.result: High transmission through sharp corner due to valley conservation

knowledge_units.context_summary: The study summarizes the development of 3D topological valley photonics, highlighting its potential for controlling light angular momentum and creating narrow-beam antennae. It notes that the concept is extendable to terahertz and optical frequencies using all-dielectric photonic crystals.

relationships.target: highly directional outcoupling from 3D valley states
